message_text: I applied 6 weeks ago and still haven't heard anything. This is ridiculous.
I understand your frustration. Typical processing time is 4-6 weeks. Let me look into your application status. Could you share your application ID?
It's APP-29381. I've been checking the portal every day and it still says 'Under Review'.
I see your application. It appears we're still waiting for your official SAT scores to arrive from College Board.
I sent those weeks ago! This is really frustrating. I've been accepted to two other schools already.
I completely understand. Sometimes electronic scores take 3-5 business days. I'll flag your application for priority review once the scores arrive.
Fine. But if I don't hear back by next week I'm withdrawing my application.
I've escalated this to our admissions team. You should receive an update within 3 business days.
